    for i,c in enumerate(h):
        if c not in tol: continue
        n+=1
        if c=='price_table': d=0 if ref[k][i]==eng[k][i] else 1
        else: d=abs(float(ref[k][i])-float(eng[k][i]))
        maxd[c]=max(maxd.get(c,0),d)

print(f"rows reference={len(ref)} engine={len(eng)} cells compared={n} deviations={len(dev)}")
for d in dev: print(d)
